subject.title: fix(agents): hard-deadline runtime auth refresh to prevent gateway deadlock

question: Should this PR require side-effect-safe cancellation or late-write guards before merging the auth timeout backstops?
rationale: The PR fixes a credible availability deadlock but changes auth-provider and runtime auth concurrency in a way that green tests do not prove safe for late side effects after a timeout.

options.title: Require late-write guards
options.body: Block merge until timed-out OAuth and runtime auth operations cannot persist credentials or mutate active auth state after their lock or single-flight ownership has ended.

options.title: Accept deadline-only mitigation
options.body: Merge the current deadline backstop as an availability mitigation while explicitly accepting possible late credential or runtime-auth writes.

options.title: Pause for auth-owner redesign
options.body: Hold this PR until an auth owner provides a concrete concurrency design and real recovery proof.

recommendation.title: Require late-write guards
recommendation.body: Block merge until timed-out OAuth and runtime auth operations cannot persist credentials or mutate active auth state after their lock or single-flight ownership has ended.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main history signal for the affected auth controller and OAuth manager paths in this checkout.
